SELECT w_state, i_item_id,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk IN (
           SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
           WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01' AND d_date < '2001-05-02'
       ) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_before,
       SUM(CASE WHEN cs_sold_date_sk IN (
           SELECT d_date_sk FROM date_dim
           WHERE d_date BETWEEN '2001-04-02' AND '2001-06-01' AND d_date >= '2001-05-02'
       ) THEN cs_sales_price - COALESCE(cr_refunded_cash, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS sales_after
FROM catalog_sales
LEFT OUTER JOIN catalog_returns ON (cs_order_number = cr_order_number AND cs_item_sk = cr_item_sk)
JOIN warehouse ON catalog_sales.cs_warehouse_sk = warehouse.w_warehouse_sk
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = catalog_sales.cs_item_sk
WHERE item.i_current_price BETWEEN 0.99 AND 1.49
GROUP BY w_state, i_item_id
ORDER BY w_state, i_item_id
LIMIT 100
